entities.name: Query alpha-tubulin acetyltransferase
observations: 413 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 46.5 kDa and theoretical pI 9.76.

Shows strongest homology to reviewed alpha-tubulin N-acetyltransferase 1 proteins, including Danio rerio Q6PH17 at 73.2% identity over 67.8% query coverage and Homo sapiens Q5SQI0 at 40.4% identity over full length.
Likely a cytosolic microtubule-associated lysine acetyltransferase; exact organism and experimental activity of this sequence are not established by sequence alone.

entities.name: Q6PH17
observations: Annotated EC 2.3.1.108; acetylates alpha-tubulin Lys-40 and acts on the microtubule lumen.
Curated catalytic activity is slow because the catalytic site is not optimized for acetyl transfer.

entities.name: Alpha-tubulin Lys40 acetylation
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:11278, RHEA:11279, and RHEA:15277 in the retrieved reference annotations.
This is the reaction assigned to alpha-tubulin N-acetyltransferase 1 homologs.
